name: Matthew
overview: The Scriptures reveal Matthew, also known as Levi, as a tax collector who was personally called by Jesus to become His disciple, leaving his former life behind (Matthew 9:9; Mark 2:14). His transformation exemplifies Jesus' grace extended to sinners, as seen when Matthew dined with other publicans and sinners, highlighting the inclusive nature of Christ's ministry (Matthew 9:10). Additionally, Matthew is listed among the twelve apostles, emphasizing his role in the foundation of the early Church (Matthew 10:3). This account underscores the power of faith and obedience in following Christ, who invites even the unlikely to participate in His redemptive work.
